##### Project general facts

Akoya Cadde Halkalı is a residential development by Reportage Türkiye, rising as three contemporary blocks across a basement, ground floor and eight upper storeys. The design language brings together natural materials — timber textures, stone surfaces and living green walls — with soft linear lighting, creating a calm, refined atmosphere throughout both the residences and the shared spaces. The project offers 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom apartments and duplex layouts with open-plan kitchens, private balconies and terraces, complemented by ground-floor retail units that bring everyday life to the street level.

Residents have access to a dedicated indoor social facility featuring a swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness centre, a sauna and a Turkish hammam, finished in the same natural, wellness-oriented palette of wood and stone. The landscaped ground floor includes children's playgrounds, pergola seating areas, outdoor benches, a walking track, a double basketball court and a tennis court. The development is further equipped with electric vehicle charging stations, a dedicated pet park, fiber optic infrastructure and gated, round-the-clock security with controlled access.

Apartments are delivered with a complete finish: fitted kitchen cabinets and countertops are installed by the developer, windows are double-glazed and insulated, bathrooms include shower areas, and select layouts feature walk-in closets, laundry and hobby rooms. Units are heated with a natural gas system, and residents benefit from private parking spaces within a controlled-access development.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Halkalı, within the Küçükçekmece district on Istanbul's European side — one of the city's most dynamic and consistently appreciating areas. The district blends historical heritage with rapid modern development, green spaces around the Küçükçekmece lake, and an expanding commercial and business landscape, making it attractive both for full-time residents and investors.

In terms of connectivity, the area benefits from proximity to Halkalı Marmaray station and the M11 metro line linking Halkalı directly to Istanbul Airport. Within easy reach are the Mall of Istanbul and ArenaPark shopping malls, Halkalı National Garden, Istanbul Sabahattin Zaim University, and hospitals including Acıbadem Atakent and Kanuni Sultan Süleyman. Everyday infrastructure — schools, shops and cafés — is well established within walking distance of the development.

Rental demand in the area is supported by nearby university and hospital catchments as well as ongoing transport upgrades, including the metro and Marmaray lines. Foreign buyers can acquire property in Turkey on a freehold basis, which, combined with the district's growth trajectory, positions Akoya Cadde Halkalı as an appealing option for both end-users and mid-term investors.
